evidence.root_cause: stale outbox snapshots were turned into recovery sessions; inherited attempt identities were then upserted under the recovery session and fresh answered_at values

fixes.RECOVERY_SUBSET_001: If the remote state already contains the stale local state, accept remote and retire the stale outbox without creating recovery.
fixes.ATTEMPT_IDENTITY_002: When closing a recovery, an existing attempt_id/client_attempt_id is resolved globally and never re-upserted merely because session_id differs.
fixes.RECOVERY_EDIT_001: If the user explicitly changes an inherited answer, detach the inherited attempt identity so the new answer gets a new attempt.
fixes.RECOVERY_FAILSAFE_001: A recovery with an inherited persisted identity that cannot be loaded refuses to fabricate a duplicate attempt.
